name: arout/rhapsody-forms
title: Forms
description: Define forms in code, drop them into any page, and manage the submissions in an inbox with email notifications and built-in spam protection.

settings_schema.label: Default notification email
settings_schema.help: Where new submissions are emailed unless a form sets its own address. Leave empty to disable email.

settings_schema.label: Minimum seconds before a form can be submitted
settings_schema.help: Bots usually submit instantly. Real visitors take longer than this.

settings_schema.label: Trusted proxy header
settings_schema.help: Only set this if the site sits behind a proxy or CDN you control, e.g. X-Forwarded-For or CF-Connecting-IP. Leave empty otherwise: a client can fake these headers.

settings_schema.label: Delete submissions after (days)
settings_schema.help: 0 keeps submissions until you delete them.

settings_schema.label: Include the default form styles
settings_schema.help: Turn off if your theme styles the .rforms-* classes itself.
